translations.name: MOCSA (Metropolitan Organization to Counter Sexual Assault)
translations.description: Free, 24/7 support for survivors of sexual abuse or assault and their families in the Kansas City area. MOCSA offers a crisis line, advocates who can go with you to the hospital, police, or court, free counseling and support groups, and legal help such as protection orders.
translations.warning: If you are in immediate danger, call 911. No application is needed. You can call the crisis line any time.
translations.website_description: 24/7 crisis line, advocacy, counseling, and legal help for survivors of sexual assault in the Kansas City area.
